diagnostics.balance_method: Actual routing intervals; trapezoidal external/spill flows; exact positive/negative split of linearly interpolated signed outfall endpoint flow. Sampling and solver approximations remain.
diagnostics.initial_state_note: Nominally dry input; actual engine-initialized node/link water is retained at t=0 and included in the balance, including SWMM's small dry-link depth floor.
diagnostics.raw_storage_units: Raw routing initStorage/finalStorage are internal ft3 in the pinned toolkit; never used as m3. All reported storage comes from converted live node/link VOLUME getters.

limitations: Research simulation only: supplied survey, source references and approval claims are not independently verified.
Only fixed geometry with a nominally dry, zero-flow start is supported; wet resets, hotstarts and measured equilibration are unsupported.
All internal nodes are explicit free-surface storage compartments. All conduit and node water is included in total storage.
Node spill leaves to declared absorbing collectors; lateral open-channel overtopping, surface transfer and re-entry are unsupported.
Zero evaporation, seepage and leakage are explicit model assumptions, not measured findings.
A numerically acceptable synthetic run does not establish physical validation or operational authority.
